claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense usage qualifier for item-mediated viewing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can encode a timed Truesight grant, but it cannot encode that the granted sense only applies while the user is actively peering through the item during the active window.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

discrepancies: tracer emitted atom 'holding_item' not in claude's claim
